I put this together from my own Russian knowledge, built around the situations we covered, and kept to simple A1-level sentences. The "sounds like" column capitalizes the stressed syllable.

I don't know whether the game has a Russian interface, so the Russian terms below are ones you and your friend can agree on, not official in-game names.

## 1. Front desk: deciding who gets in

| Russian | Sounds like | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| Пускаем! | poo-SKAH-yem | Let it in! (admit) |
| Не пускаем! | nye poo-SKAH-yem | Don't let it in! (reject) |
| Подожди! | pa-da-ZHDEE | Wait! |
| Проверь ещё раз. | pra-VYER ye-SHCHYO rahs | Check again. |
| Кто у окна? | kto oo ahk-NAH | Who's at the window? |
| Я у окна. | ya oo ahk-NAH | I'm at the window. |
| Решаю я. / Ты решаешь. | rye-SHAH-yu ya / ty rye-SHAH-yesh | I decide. / You decide. |
| Я не уверен (m) / уверена (f). | ya nye oo-VYE-ren / -ra | I'm not sure. |

## 2. Describing what you see

| Russian | Sounds like | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| Что ты видишь? | shto ty VEE-dish | What do you see? |
| Я вижу… | ya VEE-zhu | I see… |
| Фото не совпадает. | FO-to nye sahv-pa-DAH-yet | The photo doesn't match. |
| Уши другие. | OO-shi droo-GEE-ye | The ears are different. |
| Глаза чёрные. | gla-ZAH CHYOR-nye-ye | The eyes are black. |
| На камере странно. | na KAH-mye-rye STRAHN-na | It looks strange on the camera. |
| Он нормальный. | on nar-MAHL-ny | He's normal. |
| Он странный. / Она странная. | on STRAHN-ny / a-NAH STRAHN-na-ya | He's strange. / She's strange. |
| Это аномалия! | EH-ta a-na-MAH-lee-ya | It's an anomaly! |

**Body words:** голова (head), лицо (face), глаза (eyes), уши (ears), рот (mouth), зубы (teeth), лапа (paw), хвост (tail).
**Common animals:** кошка (cat), собака (dog), кролик (rabbit).

## 3. Splitting jobs and moving around

| Russian | Sounds like | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| Я на столе. | ya na sta-LYE | I'm on the desk. |
| Ты смотришь камеры? | ty SMOT-rish KAH-mye-ry | Are you watching the cameras? |
| Я иду налево. | ya ee-DOO na-LYE-va | I'm going left. |
| Где пациент? | gdye pa-tsi-YENT | Where's the patient? |
| Комната шесть. | KOM-na-ta shest | Room six. |
| Ты где? / Я здесь. | ty gdye / ya zdyes | Where are you? / I'm here. |

**Directions:** налево (left), направо (right), прямо (straight), назад (back), быстрее (faster).
**Numbers:** 1 один, 2 два, 3 три, 4 четыре, 5 пять, 6 шесть, 7 семь, 8 восемь, 9 девять, 10 десять.

## Three patterns that cover a lot

- **Давай + verb** means "let's": Давай проверим (let's check), Давай купим кофе (let's buy coffee).
- **Не + verb** is how you negate anything: Не пускаем, Не стреляй.

Gendered words change by speaker: **уверен/уверена** and **ошибся/ошиблась** (I made a mistake).

I can turn any of these sections into a quiz or flashcards, or give you a longer set for the anomaly types once you've played a shift or two.
